# NDWR Data Acquisition

Data downloaded from:
Nevada Division of Water Resources (NDWR)

Portal:
https://water.nv.gov/

Query Used:
- Basin: Pleasant Valley (PV), Truckee Meadows (TM)
- Data Types:
  - Site Data
  - Water Level Data
  - Well Logs

Download Date:
2026-05-31

File Descriptions:
- SiteData: well metadata, location, depth, perforations
- WaterLevelData: time series water levels
- WellLogQuery: supplemental metadata

Notes:
- Site Name is primary key linking all tables
- Includes both geothermal and non-geothermal wells
- Downselection for analysis occurs AFTER ingest
